## Convx 2.0.4 Nightly

Pre-release build from `main`. Nightly builds may be unstable. Please report issues in the Convx GitHub issue tracker.

### Which APK?
- **`convx-2.0.4-nightly.apk`**: for almost every phone (64-bit).
- **`convx-arm32-2.0.4-nightly.apk`**: for 32-bit-only phones.

### New in 2.0.4
- Lyrics: the active line has a seekbar-inspired chrome highlight, timed words glow as they animate, and the style is named Convx Lyrics. Custom fonts and lyric sizing are available in settings.
- Add-ons request the chosen audio quality before using a stream URL attached to search results, so lossless formats can be selected when the provider offers them, with playable fallbacks when it does not.
- Apple Music import opens in a dialog from Accounts & Services, and settings search includes every settings page and its keywords.
- Player icon presets can be reused across controls without reopening the file picker.

### Also included from 2.0.3
- Spotify login no longer identifies the sign-in page as an embedded WebView.
- Discord login reads the token through an iframe when page storage is unavailable.
- A 32-bit (arm32) APK is available for phones that cannot install the regular build.

### Also included from 2.0.2 and 2.0.1
- Fixed a playback crash caused by the playback-stats tracker.
- Playlist import and library fixes, feed refresh and pagination fixes, and reliability improvements across playback, navigation, lyrics, and appearance settings.
